rendering_findings.source_content: A TikZ picture declares a ReLU fold plot through (0,0), (1/7,1), (3/7,0), (5/7,1), and (1,0), with x and F_3(x) axes and breakpoint labels.
rendering_findings.symptom: The local HTML and tile print the literal TikZ source as text. The standalone fold chart is not rendered; its TeX commands appear in the ItemBody.
rendering_findings.note: Frozen snapshot and current source contain the same TikZ block. The screenshot receipt lists tikz_count 0 and no diagram failure, but the visible local HTML clearly exposes the raw source.

optional_typography.observation: Reference links appear as block lines. Uppercase technique banners are intentional. Plain-text compact model names such as W2 and S4 in prose/titles are treated as conventional typography; no other literal ASCII math, caret, underscore, or TeX/KaTeX leak was confirmed.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The source explicitly defines the radix-two split into even and odd subsequences, their recursive length-M/2 transforms, and the paired twiddle-factor recombination. A small q=2 butterfly can make the recursion concrete.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Show a_0,a_2 and a_1,a_3 entering the two length-2 transforms E_0,E_1 and O_0,O_1; show outputs E_k+ω^k O_k and E_k−ω^k O_k at indices k and k+M/2. Mark inverse convention as conjugate root plus division by M, if included. Do not imply a diagram is needed for correctness.
diagram_candidates.status: Optional; the exact recursive algorithm is already clear in the Definition.

existing_diagrams.review: Visible finite unrolling has θ feeding the initial map, each transition, and loss; the forward state chain is in order. This matches the source description. Cotangent flow is described in prose, not drawn as reverse arrows.
Visible diagram shows the six-cycle and two disjoint triangles with the stated vertex labels. The listed edge sets and no-cross-edge separation match the drawing. Proof does not rely on the diagram.

The plot cannot be inspected because the local renderer emits its TikZ code as text. The intended source coordinates and labels are recorded in the finding; no claim is made that the unavailable rendered chart has been visually validated.

limitations: Local Chromium capture only. This is a rendering and diagram-opportunity review, not a full mathematical audit; no live production route was inspected.
